scope: Native radio uses complete directory indexes without eagerly hydrating every indexed topic.
Radio reuses pending audio preparation during catalog progress updates.
A changed account, bank, track, audio source or release invalidates stale preparation.
Full queue identity and counts remain available; legacy unindexed content retains its fallback.

diagnosis.confirmed: Full catalog hydration and repeated playback preparation already existed in 1.3.0. Recent credential prefetch adds cold-start work; controlled progress updates reproduced cancellation of the first preparation.
diagnosis.limitation: Affected-device phase timings were not captured. No exact latency reduction or device acceptance is claimed.

checks: Force quit, reopen and enter radio at least five times; first playback should not repeat the previous long wait under normal networking.
Bank totals and queue counts stay correct and stable while loading; last item is immediately selectable.
Rapid bank and track changes play the final selection without an old request taking over.
Valid downloaded content plays offline; existing mode, interval and saved-position behavior is preserved.
deviceAcceptance.confirmation: 用户在本轮安卓与 Web 交接中明确确认 iOS 1.3.1（3596172）已验收通过；不代表新增自动化真机测量。
